Lessons.Title: The Unit Circle (Part 1)
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Calculate the radian angle measurement a point on a wheel rotates through by relating it to the distance traveled by the wheel. Describe characteristics of points on a unit circle.
One radian subtends an arc equal in length to the radius. General arc length s=rθ if θ is in radians, with signed angle indicating travel direction and physical length using absolute value.
